title: Phase 2 Open-Label Study of Targeted KRAS G12C Inhibitor in Advanced Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer

inclusion_criteria.description: Histologically confirmed Stage IV or recurrent Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC).
Documented KRAS G12C mutation in tumor tissue via NGS or PCR testing.
Received at least one prior systemic therapy line (immunotherapy or chemotherapy).
Adequate organ function: ANC >= 1,500/uL, Platelets >= 100,000/uL, eGFR >= 50 mL/min.

exclusion_criteria.description: Active, untreated brain metastases or leptomeningeal disease.
Prior treatment with a specific KRAS G12C targeted inhibitor.
